Name: Silent Dog
Author: Enzemo
Description:
Silences the dog! This removes the sound effects dog_pant and dog_bark.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]SoundTweaker[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher[/url]

Tested on 1.6.x, might work on earlier versions but hasn't been tested.


If you're interested in how this mod was made, it was all streamed live on Twitch :) [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2185030341]https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2185030341[/url]
(It's a VERY simple mod, as you'll see if you look at the source)
